name: Gfx_Scene_AllocEntryForObject
signature: GfxSceneEntry* Gfx_Scene_AllocEntryForObject(GfxSceneEntryPool* pool, void* owner, float* uvRect, u32 uvIndex, u8 tag)
summary: Allocates one 0x9C-byte scene entry from a bitmap-tracked pool (three 8-word bitmaps), attaches it to the sprite/node object in 'owner' and stores the object's 6 floats (u0,v0,u1,v1,du,dv) as 4.12 fixed point (x4096). 'tag' 1 = sprite entry, 2 = node entry (see the two create/attach wrappers).
evidence: Fills one of three 0x9C-stride slots at pool->f_18, count in f_24/f_20, free-bit bitmaps at f_1c; g_0058C1C0 = 4096.0f used as the fixed-point scale for the UV rect; called by both sprite (0x58EBA0) and node (0x58EE64) creators with tag 1 / 2.

name: maybe_Gfx_SpriteParts_Add14
signature: void maybe_Gfx_SpriteParts_Add14(GfxSpriteParts* parts, u64* record, u32 index)
summary: Appends a 0x14-byte part record (two u64 values + u16 index) to the small vector inside a stack sprite-part builder and sets the dirty flag (+0x60 |= 2). Used by Gfx_Scene_CreateSpriteVariantA before the sprite instance is created.
evidence: Writes 0x14 bytes (2 u64 + u16) at parts->f_68; grows via func_007082F4 with the /5 magic 0x66666667; called from 0x2E76F8 which builds the builder on the stack, calls it, then Gfx_Scene_CreateSpriteInstance and 0x58C4A0 (clear).

name: maybe_Gfx_SpriteParts_Add40
signature: void maybe_Gfx_SpriteParts_Add40(GfxSpriteParts* parts, u64* record, u32 index)
summary: Appends a 0x28-byte part record (a 16-byte key from func_00665618, two more u64 values and a u16 index) to the second vector of the sprite-part builder.
evidence: Writes 0x28 bytes at parts->f_78 after calling func_00665618 for the first 16 bytes; grow helper func_00708458; caller 0x2E77CC (Gfx_Scene_CreateSpriteVariantB) and 0x337CB4.

name: maybe_Gfx_SpriteParts_Add44
signature: void maybe_Gfx_SpriteParts_Add44(GfxSpriteParts* parts, u64* record, u32 index)
summary: Appends a 0x2C-byte part record (four u64/32-bit values plus u16 index) to the third vector of the sprite-part builder.
evidence: Writes 0x2C bytes at parts->f_88; grow helper func_00708600; called by Gfx_Scene_TransformPoint, 0x337CB4 and 0x4E4BF8 (Ui3D effect pair init).

name: Gfx_SpriteParts_Clear
summary: Releases the three part vectors of the stack sprite-part builder (0x2C-, 0x28- and 0x14-byte elements) through the allocator in the element owner's vtable slot +0x14 and zeroes all capacity fields.
evidence: Walks f_84/f_88 (0x2C), f_74/f_78 (0x28), f_64/f_68 (0x14) and calls (*(*owner)+0x14)(owner, first) for each, then clears the triples; called at the end of 0x2E76F8 / 0x2E77CC / 0x4E4BF8.

name: Gfx_DrawPacket_BuildFormat2
signature: void Gfx_DrawPacket_BuildFormat2(GfxDrawPacket* packet, int countA, int countB, GfxDrawParams* params)
summary: Builds a two-batch draw packet for vertex format 2 (primitive type id 2): reserves one buffer with Gfx_DrawPacket_ResizeBuffer, lays out two 0x40-byte batch headers, 0x20-byte vertices and 16-bit index lists, and copies the transform/colour parameters into both headers.
evidence: Arg1[3] := 2 (format id), header magic FLT_MAX (g_0058C6D0) at +4; sizes count*0x20 vertices + aligned u16 indices; the caller 0x58E770 feeds the result to the A-variant triangle intersector, i.e. the packet layout is only used as a mesh for hit tests.

name: Gfx_DrawPacket_ResizeBuffer
summary: Makes sure the packet owns a buffer of at least 'bytes' bytes: frees the old block through the allocator vtable's +0x14, allocates via +0xC and zero-fills the new one. Returns the buffer (0 on failure).
evidence: packet->f_14 is the allocator object; calls (*vtbl+0x14)(alloc, old) then (*vtbl+0xC)(alloc, 4, bytes) and func_001113EC(buf, bytes) (memset); callers are the three Gfx_DrawPacket_BuildFormat* functions that pass exact byte counts.

name: Gfx_DrawPacket_BuildFormat3
signature: void Gfx_DrawPacket_BuildFormat3(GfxDrawPacket* packet, int countA, int countB, GfxDrawParams* params)
summary: Same two-batch packet layout as Gfx_DrawPacket_BuildFormat2 but for vertex format 3, carrying eight parameter words per batch instead of four.
evidence: Arg1[3] := 3; FLT_MAX magic written at +8 and +0xC; copies params[0..7] into both headers; caller 0x58E918 (B-variant hit test).

name: Gfx_DrawPacket_Release
summary: Frees the packet's vertex buffer through the allocator vtable and resets the 8-word packet struct to its empty state (type 0, size limit g_0058CAEC).
evidence: Frees packet[5] (allocator) payload if packet[6] non-zero, then zeroes packet[0..7]; called from the scene reset paths 0x58E2E4 and 0x58F054.

name: Gfx_DrawPacket_BuildFormat1
signature: void Gfx_DrawPacket_BuildFormat1(GfxDrawPacket* packet, int countA, int countB, GfxDrawParams* params)
summary: Two-batch packet build for vertex format 1 (the most parameter-rich header: eight words per batch).
evidence: Arg1[3] := 1; FLT_MAX magic at +4; copies params[0..6] per batch; caller 0x58E3F4 (C-variant hit test).

name: maybe_Container_ObjectRef_Release
summary: Releases the object referenced by a 5-word handle struct: if both the owner pointer (+4) and the element count (+8) are set, frees through the owner vtable +0x14 and clears +4..+0x10.
evidence: Same allocator-vtable protocol as Gfx_DrawPacket_Release; used by Font_CacheGlyphsForText and Gfx_Scene_CreateSpritesFromResource for locally kept sub-objects, and by the tiny ctor 0x58D2BC.

name: Gfx_Scene_ReleaseEntryAttachments
summary: Detaches an entry from its owner: returns the three 0x28-byte transform slots to the node animator at f_94 (count--, state 7), drops the f_90 owner and unlinks the three intrusive list nodes embedded in the entry.
evidence: Uses f_94->f_18 (slot count) and the 0x18/0x28 strides plus func_0010EBE4 (matrix copy) exactly like Gfx_Scene_AllocEntryForObject's tail; called only from Gfx_Scene_ReleaseEntry (0x58A248).

name: maybe_Container_ObjectRef_Init
signature: u32 maybe_Container_ObjectRef_Init(ContainerObjectRef* ref, u32 object, u32 capacity)
summary: Initialises a 5-word object-reference handle: releases the previous contents, stores the object id at +0xC and prepares the inline bitmap/buffer area.
evidence: Calls 0x58D00C (release) then 0x58D04C(ref, capacity) which fills the 0x40-byte area at +0x10 with 0x3F; no callers found in the decompiled tree (constructor called indirectly).

name: Gfx_Scene_Entry_Release
summary: Destroys the contents of one 0x9C scene entry: frees the attachment buffer at +0x80 through its allocator, then zeroes the entry's owner, transform and link fields so the slot can be reused.
evidence: Called for each 0x9C slot by Gfx_Scene_ReleaseEntryPools (0x588748) and by Gfx_Scene_DestroySpriteByHandle/List and ReleaseAllEntries; frees entry->f_80 (allocator) payload and clears f_7C..f_98.

name: Gfx_Scene_SortEntriesForDraw
summary: Re-sorts the scene entry draw order: merges the two sorted intrusive lists of each of the three axis buckets by the entry key at +0xC (std::list::merge with the comparator), then insertion-sorts the three bucket distances ascending.
evidence: self->f_18 = bucket count, f_1C = axis mask; merges via func_001235A4 (list splice) and 0x57989C; the merge comparator reads +0xC and the sort swaps the distance floats, with a /10 and /100 divisor via 0x4EC4EC4F/0x39800000; called at the head of all three scene query entries.

name: Gfx_Scene_ResetPools
summary: Releases the whole scene container: destroys every 0x9C entry (std_destroy_range) and every 0x74 node pool, frees both pools and resets all query/batch state, then clears the draw packet.
evidence: Loops f_C4 entries of 0x9C at f_BC and f_B0 nodes at f_AC, frees f_B8/f_A8 with vtable+0x14, zeroes ~40 fields, calls Gfx_Scene_ReleaseEntryPools(&f_2C) and Gfx_DrawPacket_Release(&f_C); called by Gfx_Scene_ReleaseAll and the scene destructor 0x58F054.

name: Gfx_Scene_TestSpriteHitC
signature: u32 Gfx_Scene_TestSpriteHitC(GfxScene* scene, GfxQuery* query, GfxHit* out, u32 useMesh, u32 mask, u16 layer, u32 userData)
summary: Third of the three scene hit tests: collects entries along a ray (Gfx_Scene_CollectRayCandidates) and via the capsule query, builds packet format 1 from them, walks the node/mesh tree with the C-variant intersectors, and returns the closest hit record (id, two shorts, distance fixed at 0).
evidence: Calls Gfx_Scene_QueryCapsule + Gfx_Scene_CollectRayCandidates + 0x580A88/0x583398/0x586494 (C variants) and Gfx_DrawPacket_BuildFormat1 (0x58CAF0); only caller is maybe_Gfx_Scene_DrawSpriteVariant.

name: Gfx_Scene_TestSpriteHitA
signature: u32 Gfx_Scene_TestSpriteHitA(GfxScene* scene, GfxQuery* query, GfxHit* out, u32 useMesh, u32 mask, u16 layer, u32 userData)
summary: First of the three scene hit tests: sphere candidates are collected, packed into vertex format 2, intersected with the A-variant triangle soup / mesh walker, and the nearest hit is written to 'out' with its distance measured from the query origin.
evidence: Gfx_Scene_QuerySphereCandidates + 0x57EF20/0x58188C/0x58417C (A variants) + Gfx_DrawPacket_BuildFormat2 (0x58C580); called by Gfx_Scene_DrawSprite and Gfx_Scene_FindEntriesAlongLine, and 0x2E72C8 re-invokes it in a loop to ray-march (uses the returned distance).

name: Gfx_Scene_TestSpriteHitB
signature: u32 Gfx_Scene_TestSpriteHitB(GfxScene* scene, GfxQuery* query, GfxHit* out, u32 useMesh, u32 mask, u16 layer, u32 userData)
summary: Second of the three scene hit tests: swept-sphere candidates plus segment candidates are packed into vertex format 3 and intersected with the B-variant walkers; the hit distance comes from the segment parameter.
evidence: Gfx_Scene_QuerySphereSweep + Gfx_Scene_CollectSegmentCandidates + 0x57F59C/0x581EC0/0x584C70 (B variants) + Gfx_DrawPacket_BuildFormat3 (0x58C758); only caller is Gfx_Scene_DrawSpriteEx.

name: Gfx_Scene_CreateSpriteWithEntry
signature: int Gfx_Scene_CreateSpriteWithEntry(GfxScene* scene, u32 handle, u32 resource, u32 userData, u8 index)
summary: Creates a scene sprite from a resource handle and immediately allocates its hit-test entry (tag 1) from the object transform; on failure the sprite is destroyed again so the call is atomic.
evidence: Gfx_Scene_CreateSpriteFromHandle(&scene->f_2C, ...) then Gfx_Scene_AllocEntryForObject(&scene->f_A4, sprite, sprite->f_34, index, 1) and Gfx_Scene_DestroyNodeByIndex on failure; called by 0x58EC10.

name: Gfx_Scene_CreateOrAttachSpriteEntry
signature: int Gfx_Scene_CreateOrAttachSpriteEntry(FieldModelObject* obj, u32 handle, u32 userData, int resource)

evidence: Branches on arg4: 0 -> Gfx_Scene_FindSpriteByHandle(...,1) + Gfx_Scene_AllocEntryForObject; else tail-calls 0x58EBA0; only caller is Field_ModelObj_CreateSprite.

name: Gfx_Scene_AttachSpriteEntry
signature: int Gfx_Scene_AttachSpriteEntry(GfxScene* scene, u32 handle, u32 userData, u32 flag)
summary: Attaches a hit-test entry to an already existing scene sprite (looked up by handle) using the sprite's current transform; destroys the sprite if the entry cannot be allocated.
evidence: Gfx_Scene_FindSpriteByHandle(scene+0x2C, handle, flag) then Gfx_Scene_AllocEntryForObject(scene+0xA4, sprite, &sprite->f_34, userData, 1); no callers found in the decompiled tree (called through a vtable/thunk).

name: Gfx_Scene_DeleteSpriteWithEntry
summary: Destroys a scene sprite together with its hit-test entry (the entry is returned to the pool first).
evidence: Resolves the sprite object, releases its entry at +0x20 via Gfx_Scene_ReleaseEntry(&scene->f_A4) and calls Gfx_Scene_DestroyNodeByIndex(&scene->f_2C, handle); no callers in the decompiled tree.

name: Gfx_Scene_DeleteSpriteEntryList
summary: Walks an intrusive list of scene sprites, releases every attached entry, then destroys the sprite list in one call.
evidence: Iterates from head->f_4 until the sentinel and frees the entry of every node with +0x20 set, then maybe_Gfx_Scene_DestroyNodeListByIndex; callers Gfx_Scene_RemoveSpriteEntries and maybe_Battle_PopupPool_Clear.

name: Gfx_Scene_CreateNodeWithEntry
signature: int Gfx_Scene_CreateNodeWithEntry(GfxScene* scene, u32 handle, u32 resource, u32 userData, u8 index)
summary: Node counterpart of Gfx_Scene_CreateSpriteWithEntry: creates a 0x74-byte scene node and allocates its hit-test entry with tag 2.
evidence: Gfx_Scene_CreateNodeFromHandle(&scene->f_2C,...) then Gfx_Scene_AllocEntryForObject(&scene->f_A4, node, node->f_34, index, 2) with rollback via 0x58971C; caller 0x58EED4.

name: Gfx_Scene_CreateOrAttachNodeEntry
signature: int Gfx_Scene_CreateOrAttachNodeEntry(FieldModelObject* obj, int handle, u32 userData, int resource)

name: Gfx_Scene_AttachNodeEntry
signature: int Gfx_Scene_AttachNodeEntry(GfxScene* scene, u32 handle, u32 userData, u32 flag)

name: Gfx_Scene_Delete
summary: Deleting destructor of the Gfx_Scene object: runs Gfx_Scene_Release and frees the storage (operator delete at 0x10F6CC).

name: Gfx_Scene_Release
summary: Destructor of the scene container: releases the pools, the query state and every remaining sub-buffer (all freed through their allocator vtable) and sets the vtable pointer.

name: Model_CopyParamBlock
signature: void Model_CopyParamBlock(ModelParamBlock* dst, const ModelParamBlock* src)
summary: Copies a model parameter block (~0x10C bytes) and repairs the five self-relative pointers inside it (at +0x24, +0x34, +0x44, +0x54, +0x64), so the copy can live at another address.

name: maybe_Text_WordData_Copy
signature: void maybe_Text_WordData_Copy(TextWordData* dst, const TextWordData* src, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)

summary: Copy-constructs a 0x38-byte actor/UI entry record, repairing its three self-relative pointers (+4, +0xC, +0x14) and copying the embedded 5-byte id/flag pair.
